dialogue.text: As part of We the People celebrating 250 years.
dialogue.zh: 作為「我們人民」慶祝250週年的一部分。
dialogue.ja: 「私たち国民」の一環として250周年を祝います。
dialogue.local: As part of We the People celebrating 250 years.
dialogue.en: As part of We the People celebrating 250 years.

dialogue.text: Here's this day in history.
dialogue.zh: 這是歷史上的今天。
dialogue.ja: 今日は歴史のこの日です。
dialogue.local: Here's this day in history.
dialogue.en: Here's this day in history.

dialogue.text: We continue to celebrate America's 250th birthday this summer.
dialogue.zh: 我們今年夏天繼續慶祝美國250歲生日。
dialogue.ja: 今年の夏もアメリカの250歳の誕生日を祝います。
dialogue.local: We continue to celebrate America's 250th birthday this summer.
dialogue.en: We continue to celebrate America's 250th birthday this summer.

dialogue.text: We're sharing our We the People series,
dialogue.zh: 我們正在分享「我們人民」系列，
dialogue.ja: 「私たち国民」シリーズをお届けしています。
dialogue.local: We're sharing our We the People series,
dialogue.en: We're sharing our We the People series,

dialogue.text: people places and things of the past that have shaped our country
dialogue.zh: 過去塑造我們國家的人物、地點和事物，
dialogue.ja: 私たちの国を形作った過去の人々、場所、物事を紹介します。
dialogue.local: people places and things of the past that have shaped our country
dialogue.en: people places and things of the past that have shaped our country

dialogue.text: what it is today, including something to do with our full moon out there.
dialogue.zh: 以及它今天的樣貌，包括與我們那邊的滿月有關的事情。
dialogue.ja: 今日の姿、そしてあそこにある満月に関係することも含みます。
dialogue.local: what it is today, including something to do with our full moon out there.
dialogue.en: what it is today, including something to do with our full moon out there.

dialogue.text: Nice timing, Charlie.
dialogue.zh: 時機真好，查理。
dialogue.ja: いいタイミングだね、チャーリー。
dialogue.local: Nice timing, Charlie.
dialogue.en: Nice timing, Charlie.

dialogue.text: Yeah, on this stage of July 29, 1958, NASA was created.
dialogue.zh: 是的，在1958年7月29日這一天，NASA成立了。
dialogue.ja: そうですね、1958年7月29日にNASAが設立されました。
dialogue.local: Yeah, on this stage of July 29, 1958, NASA was created.
dialogue.en: Yeah, on this stage of July 29, 1958, NASA was created.

dialogue.text: The agency has been responsible for space expeditions,
dialogue.zh: 該機構負責太空探險，
dialogue.ja: この機関は宇宙探査を担当しています。
dialogue.local: The agency has been responsible for space expeditions,
dialogue.en: The agency has been responsible for space expeditions,

dialogue.text: both human and mechanical that have yielded vital information
dialogue.zh: 包括人類和機械的任務，提供了重要資訊，
dialogue.ja: 人間と機械の両方の探査で重要な情報をもたらしました。
dialogue.local: both human and mechanical that have yielded vital information
dialogue.en: both human and mechanical that have yielded vital information

dialogue.text: about the solar system and the universe.
dialogue.zh: 關於太陽系和宇宙的知識。
dialogue.ja: 太陽系や宇宙についての情報です。
dialogue.local: about the solar system and the universe.
dialogue.en: about the solar system and the universe.

dialogue.text: NASA was created in response to the Soviet Union's launch
dialogue.zh: NASA的成立是為了回應蘇聯發射
dialogue.ja: NASAはソ連の打ち上げに対応して設立されました。
dialogue.local: NASA was created in response to the Soviet Union's launch
dialogue.en: NASA was created in response to the Soviet Union's launch

dialogue.text: of its first satellite, Sputnik 1,
dialogue.zh: 它的第一顆衛星，史潑尼克1號，
dialogue.ja: 最初の人工衛星スプートニク1号の打ち上げです。
dialogue.local: of its first satellite, Sputnik 1,
dialogue.en: of its first satellite, Sputnik 1,

dialogue.text: the 183-pound basketball-sized satellite
dialogue.zh: 這顆重達183磅、大小如籃球的衛星
dialogue.ja: 183ポンドのバスケットボール大の衛星で、
dialogue.local: the 183-pound basketball-sized satellite
dialogue.en: the 183-pound basketball-sized satellite

dialogue.text: orbited the Earth in 98 minutes.
dialogue.zh: 在98分鐘內繞地球一圈。
dialogue.ja: 98分で地球を周回しました。
dialogue.local: orbited the Earth in 98 minutes.
dialogue.en: orbited the Earth in 98 minutes.

dialogue.text: The Sputnik launch caught Americans by surprise
dialogue.zh: 史潑尼克的發射讓美國人措手不及，
dialogue.ja: スプートニクの打ち上げはアメリカ人を驚かせました。
dialogue.local: The Sputnik launch caught Americans by surprise
dialogue.en: The Sputnik launch caught Americans by surprise

dialogue.text: and sparked fears that Soviets might also be capable
dialogue.zh: 並引發了對蘇聯可能也有能力
dialogue.ja: そしてソ連がまた能力を持っているのではないかという恐怖を引き起こしました。
dialogue.local: and sparked fears that Soviets might also be capable
dialogue.en: and sparked fears that Soviets might also be capable

dialogue.text: of sending missiles with nuclear weapons from Europe to America.
dialogue.zh: 從歐洲向美國發射搭載核武器的導彈。
dialogue.ja: ヨーロッパからアメリカへ核兵器搭載ミサイルを発射できるかもしれないと。
dialogue.local: of sending missiles with nuclear weapons from Europe to America.
dialogue.en: of sending missiles with nuclear weapons from Europe to America.

dialogue.text: The United States prided itself on being at the forefront of technology
dialogue.zh: 美國以處於科技前沿為傲，
dialogue.ja: アメリカは技術の最先端にいることを誇りに思っていました。
dialogue.local: The United States prided itself on being at the forefront of technology
dialogue.en: The United States prided itself on being at the forefront of technology

dialogue.text: and embarrassed it immediately began developing a response,
dialogue.zh: 感到尷尬，立即開始發展對策，
dialogue.ja: そして恥ずかしく思い、すぐに対応策の開発を始めました。
dialogue.local: and embarrassed it immediately began developing a response,
dialogue.en: and embarrassed it immediately began developing a response,

dialogue.text: signaling the start of the US Soviet Space Race.
dialogue.zh: 標誌著美蘇太空競賽的開始。
dialogue.ja: これが米ソ宇宙競争の始まりを告げました。
dialogue.local: signaling the start of the US Soviet Space Race.
dialogue.en: signaling the start of the US Soviet Space Race.

dialogue.text: On July 20, 1969, NASA's Apollo 11 mission made history
dialogue.zh: 1969年7月20日，NASA的阿波羅11號任務創造了歷史，
dialogue.ja: 1969年7月20日、NASAのアポロ11号ミッションが歴史を作りました。
dialogue.local: On July 20, 1969, NASA's Apollo 11 mission made history
dialogue.en: On July 20, 1969, NASA's Apollo 11 mission made history

dialogue.text: when astronaut Neil Armstrong became the first person
dialogue.zh: 當時宇航員尼爾·阿姆斯壯成為第一個人，
dialogue.ja: 宇宙飛行士ニール・アームストロングが初めて人類として、
dialogue.local: when astronaut Neil Armstrong became the first person
dialogue.en: when astronaut Neil Armstrong became the first person

dialogue.text: to set foot on the moon famously declaring
dialogue.zh: 踏上月球，並著名地宣稱
dialogue.ja: 月に足を踏み入れ、有名な言葉を残しました。
dialogue.local: to set foot on the moon famously declaring
dialogue.en: to set foot on the moon famously declaring

dialogue.text: "That's one small step for man, one giant leap for mankind."
dialogue.zh: 「這是個人的一小步，卻是人類的一大步。」
dialogue.ja: 「これは人間にとって小さな一歩だが、人類にとっては大きな飛躍だ。」
dialogue.local: "That's one small step for man, one giant leap for mankind."
dialogue.en: "That's one small step for man, one giant leap for mankind."

dialogue.text: NASA has continued to make great advances in space exploration
dialogue.zh: NASA持續在太空探索方面取得重大進展，
dialogue.ja: NASAは宇宙探査で大きな進歩を続けています。
dialogue.local: NASA has continued to make great advances in space exploration
dialogue.en: NASA has continued to make great advances in space exploration

dialogue.text: since the first moonwalk, including playing a major part
dialogue.zh: 自首次登月以來，包括在國際太空站建造中扮演重要角色。
dialogue.ja: 最初の月面歩行以来、国際宇宙ステーションの建設にも大きく関わっています。
dialogue.local: since the first moonwalk, including playing a major part
dialogue.en: since the first moonwalk, including playing a major part

dialogue.text: in the construction of the International Space Station.
dialogue.zh: 在國際太空站的建造中。
dialogue.ja: 国際宇宙ステーションの建設においてです。
dialogue.local: in the construction of the International Space Station.
dialogue.en: in the construction of the International Space Station.

dialogue.text: That's the stay in history for July 29.
dialogue.zh: 這就是7月29日的歷史事件。
dialogue.ja: これが7月29日の歴史の出来事です。
dialogue.local: That's the stay in history for July 29.
dialogue.en: That's the stay in history for July 29.

dialogue.text: And we learned last month that you remember exactly
dialogue.zh: 我們上個月得知你還記得很清楚
dialogue.ja: そして先月、あなたが正確に覚えていることを知りました。
dialogue.local: And we learned last month that you remember exactly
dialogue.en: And we learned last month that you remember exactly

dialogue.text: where you were watching that first moon landing,
dialogue.zh: 當時你在哪裡觀看第一次登月，
dialogue.ja: その最初の月面着陸をどこで見ていたかを。
dialogue.local: where you were watching that first moon landing,
dialogue.en: where you were watching that first moon landing,

dialogue.text: which is so cool.
dialogue.zh: 真是太酷了。
dialogue.ja: それはとても素敵なことです。
dialogue.local: which is so cool.
dialogue.en: which is so cool.

dialogue.text: I do. I can remember the kitchen table even.
dialogue.zh: 我記得，甚至記得廚房的桌子。
dialogue.ja: 覚えています。キッチンのテーブルまでも覚えています。
dialogue.local: I do. I can remember the kitchen table even.
dialogue.en: I do. I can remember the kitchen table even.

dialogue.text: That's just so wild.
dialogue.zh: 真是太不可思議了。
dialogue.ja: それは本当にすごいことです。
dialogue.local: That's just so wild.
dialogue.en: That's just so wild.

dialogue.text: Todd, yeah, but I have zero memory prior to that.
dialogue.zh: 托德，是的，但我之前完全沒有記憶。
dialogue.ja: トッド、そうだけど、それ以前の記憶は全くありません。
dialogue.local: Todd, yeah, but I have zero memory prior to that.
dialogue.en: Todd, yeah, but I have zero memory prior to that.

dialogue.text: Birth, moon.
dialogue.zh: 出生，月球。
dialogue.ja: 誕生、月。
dialogue.local: Birth, moon.
dialogue.en: Birth, moon.

dialogue.text: Birth, moon.
dialogue.zh: 出生，月球。
dialogue.ja: 誕生、月。
dialogue.local: Birth, moon.
dialogue.en: Birth, moon.

dialogue.text: Birth, moon, moon.
dialogue.zh: 出生，月球，月球。
dialogue.ja: 誕生、月、月。
dialogue.local: Birth, moon, moon.
dialogue.en: Birth, moon, moon.

dialogue.text: Yeah, birth, table and man walking on the moon.
dialogue.zh: 是的，出生、桌子和人在月球上行走。
dialogue.ja: そう、誕生、テーブル、そして月面を歩く人。
dialogue.local: Yeah, birth, table and man walking on the moon.
dialogue.en: Yeah, birth, table and man walking on the moon.

dialogue.text: It's everything prior to that is just a big blank.
dialogue.zh: 之前的一切都是一片空白。
dialogue.ja: それ以前のことはすべて真っ白な記憶です。
dialogue.local: It's everything prior to that is just a big blank.
dialogue.en: It's everything prior to that is just a big blank.

dialogue.text: Oh, man.
dialogue.zh: 喔，天啊。
dialogue.ja: ああ、もう。
dialogue.local: Oh, man.
dialogue.en: Oh, man.

dialogue.text: Well, yeah, it's just super impressive what these astronauts are capable of.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，是的，這些宇航員的能力真令人印象深刻。
dialogue.ja: そうですね、宇宙飛行士たちの能力は本当に素晴らしいです。
dialogue.local: Well, yeah, it's just super impressive what these astronauts are capable of.
dialogue.en: Well, yeah, it's just super impressive what these astronauts are capable of.

dialogue.text: And even for that last orbit around the moon,
dialogue.zh: 甚至在最後一次繞月軌道時，
dialogue.ja: そして最後の月周回の時でさえ、
dialogue.local: And even for that last orbit around the moon,
dialogue.en: And even for that last orbit around the moon,

dialogue.text: we learned that there was an astronaut, somebody within NASA from Green Bay who we spoke with.
dialogue.zh: 我們得知有一位來自綠灣的NASA宇航員，我們曾與他交談過。
dialogue.ja: グリーンベイ出身のNASAの宇宙飛行士がいて、私たちは話をしました。
dialogue.local: we learned that there was an astronaut, somebody within NASA from Green Bay who we spoke with.
dialogue.en: we learned that there was an astronaut, somebody within NASA from Green Bay who we spoke with.

dialogue.text: So it's just super cool to see all of these Wisconsin connections to NASA as well, Charlie, thank you.
dialogue.zh: 所以看到這些威斯康辛州與NASA的連結真的很酷，查理，謝謝你。
dialogue.ja: だから、ウィスコンシン州とNASAのつながりを見るのは本当に素敵です。チャーリー、ありがとう。
dialogue.local: So it's just super cool to see all of these Wisconsin connections to NASA as well, Charlie, thank you.
dialogue.en: So it's just super cool to see all of these Wisconsin connections to NASA as well, Charlie, thank you.
